name: IMO Prelim Past Paper
statement:
$\triangle ABC$ has area 1 and has $AB > AC$. 
The internal bisector of $\angle A$ meets $BC$ at $D$, 
and $\triangle DBC' \sim \triangle ABC$ where $C'$ is the image of $C$ 
upon reflection across $AD$. 
When the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ is minimised, find the length of $AB$.
